icons:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: one production navigation sprite atlas for a Korean tactical RPG called REVERSE CALL, exact 8 columns by 8 rows uniform 64-cell grid, square 2048 x 2048, each cell 256 x 256. Background genuinely transparent; no grid lines or labels.
Style: premium restrained military command-interface pictograms, crisp ivory-white thin engraved line drawings of actual objects, a few muted cool gray fills, very subtle cyan accents. Distinct recognizable illustrated silhouettes, coherent consistent weight and perspective, readable at 32 pixels. Like a refined tactical anime management game HUD. Not emoji, not rounded app logos, no colored tile backplates, no frames, no lettering, no numbers. Each illustration centered precisely at its cell center, all strokes confined to central 164 by 164 pixels leaving 46 pixels safe padding on every side. Do not add shadows outside the icon. All 64 cells occupied exactly in this reading order:
Row 1: command headquarters building; open dossier book; stack of character cards; armored knight bust; sitting cat companion; reinforcement hammer and star; butterfly emerging from a card; two cards merging.
Row 2: arcane grimoire; compass; fanned five-card squad; snarling wolf head; horned dragon head; three soldier helmets; armored transport truck; fortress gate with shield.
Row 3: sealed padlock and chains; legion ranks of three shields; tall watchtower; scrap car with cog; pickaxe and crystal; crossed straight swords; paired swords with two shields; colosseum amphitheater.
Row 4: skyline of a city; laurel trophy; clan banner; two opposing clan flags; three territorial banners; imperial crown; folded territory map with flag; armored breastplate.
Row 5: medal ribbon; racing car; human portrait bust; anvil and smith hammer; car chassis and wrench; alchemist flask; wrapped gift box; checked calendar.
Row 6: mission clipboard; sealed envelope; two exchanged mineral crystals; sports scoreboard; auction gavel; rugged inventory chest; carnival ferris wheel; barred prison door.
Row 7: guarded prison watchtower; military administration building; globe; ornate small star bookmark; field binoculars; magnifying glass; weapons rack; metal forge furnace.
Row 8: supply storefront; pig coin; elite season pass ticket; command console keyboard; gear settings; fullscreen optical sight; chicken meal box; double headed battle axe.
Constraints: match every listed object to its exact cell, no duplicates, no omitted cells, no typography, transparent negative space, white strokes must stay visible on a dark navy game interface.
panel: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: a single reusable production tactical game information panel skin. Square 1024x1024, straight-on orthographic. Genuine transparent canvas. One restrained dark slate blue translucent smoked-glass UI panel filling the canvas. Outer 48-pixel border contains exceptionally thin cool-white technical edge lines, four small white rectangular corner registration accents, a few tiny white tick notches. Border is minimalist thin utilitarian printed UI, no ornate fantasy frame, no bevel bulges, no screws, no thick housing, no scenery. The middle 928x928 area is uniform semi-transparent deep slate blue (#213b50 at about 78% opacity); absolutely empty, for readable DOM text and controls to be placed later. Thin frame lines at x=16,1008 and y=16,1008. Each corner detail confined to its outermost 48px so it works as a nine-slice scalable interface window. Inspired by sparse white-outline command information windows in modern anime tactical management games. No text, no symbols in center, no logos, no arrows, no gradients or glows in the center. Output only this single square UI surface with real alpha channel, no checkerboard.
